body.statement: If all four cell densities are uniform, then \(p=T=R_0=\operatorname{id}\), \(\alpha=1\), \(\mathcal D_P[\delta]=\nabla(-\Delta)^{-1}(-\delta_{C0}+\delta_{C1}+\delta_{T0}-\delta_{T1})\), and equal cell sizes give \(V_j=I_2/\pi\). In the fixed-source subexperiment with only \(P_{T1}\) sampled, the covariance reduces to \(I_2/(4\pi)\), exactly the known uniform dimension-two result.
body.justification: The reduction is an auditable sign, scale, and angular-constant check for the nested formula.
body.gap: ManoleBalakrishnanNilesWeedWasserman2023CLT proves the final one-cell reduction but does not derive the four-cell \(I_2/\pi\) nested covariance.
body.consumer: The identity is a unit test for Fourier and adjoint solvers before the nonconstant-coefficient experiment is attempted.
